purpose: Host-neutral no-scan installation/adaptation evidence contract. It cannot mint project authority and it cannot declare success from configuration alone.

classification.NATIVE: Minimum reads and current authority resolve; native lifecycle is actually available; hook fire is observed; durable state write is observed; and effect request/result receipts are observed when effects are part of the integration.
classification.ADAPTED: Minimum reads/current authority resolve; a non-native adapter lifecycle is actually verified; durable state write is observed; effect request/result receipts are observed when effects are part of the integration.
classification.DEGRADED: Repository/source access works, but lifecycle, durable state, hook, or effect/result evidence required for NATIVE/ADAPTED is missing.
classification.BLOCKED: Minimum required repository reads or current authority resolution cannot be verified.
